question: The shortcut key to 'copy' selected text in Windows is :
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + C**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Ctrl + C is the universal shortcut key for copying text or objects in Windows.**
 
• It is widely used in various applications such as Word, Excel, browsers, and others.
 
• **This command replicates the selected text or object to the clipboard without removing it from the original location.**
 
• Users can then paste the copied content elsewhere using the Ctrl + V shortcut.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Ctrl + V:** Used to paste the copied or cut content from the clipboard.
 
• **Ctrl + P:** Shortcut key for printing documents or files.
 
• **Ctrl + X:** Used to cut selected text or objects, removing them from their original location and placing them on the clipboard.
 
• **Clipboard:** A temporary storage area in Windows used for storing copied or cut content.
